 David Muir shares glimpse into birthday weekend in $7 million lakeside home
 The ABC news anchor shared a photo of his beloved dog Axel ahead of celebrating his 53rd birthday
 © Getty Images 
 Beatriz Colon New York Writer New York 17 hours ago Nov 8, 2026, 8:55 PM GMT LEAVE A COMMENT 
 David Muir is celebrating his birthday with his most trusted companion.
 On Sunday, November 8, the ABC news anchor celebrated his 53rd trip around the sun.
 And though the veteran journalist is notoriously private about his personal life, he did share a glimpse into his birthday weekend featuring his beloved dog Axel.
 View post on Instagram   
 One day before his special day, David took to Instagram and shared a photo of Axel, his German Shorthaired Pointer of seven years.
 The zoomed in photo sees the pup with some white hair around his face, seemingly frolicking through a forest surrounded with autumn leaves.
 David simply captioned the post with a fall-hued leaf, and fans were quick to take to the comments section under the post and gush over it, with one noting: "David, you may have the evening news, but this handsome fella looks like he's got a few stories of his own worth reporting!"
 © Instagram David has had Axel for seven years 
 Others followed suit with: "He's an adult now with a grey beard," a heart emoji, and: "Awwww Axel probably wagging his tail, hopefully your having a good day on your little adventure and listening to the birds whisperings and chirping out there by the lake," as well as: "Axel, you are such a precious soul. Have an awesome weekend sweetheart."
 Recommended video You may also like WATCH: David Muir shared a glimpse of his weekend off work at ABC News 
 David is based in Manhattan, where he previously owned a townhouse in the West Village, which was reportedly listed for sale in May 2025.
 You may also like
 David Muir reveals what people actually say to him on the street in rare personal interview 
 In addition to his Manhattan home, David, who was born in Syracuse and grew up in Onondaga Hills, also spends time in his upstate New York home. 
 © Instagram The anchor during a summer vacation earlier this year 
 He purchased the property, on Skaneateles Lake, for a whopping $7 million, according to records filed with the Onondaga County Clerk's office in 2019. Built in 1890, the 4,300-square foot residence boasts six bedrooms, two kitchens, three bathrooms, and a stunning fireplace.
 Accepting an award at the Library of American Broadcasting Foundation 
 "I'd say my most comfortable element is being outside, covered in mud," David told People in May 2025, adding of Axel: "I have a German short-haired pointer, and for him, the biggest event of the weekend was discovering there was a beaver who had begun to build a dam inside the little boathouse."
 "When you're out there on the lake, smelling the same air that you smelled when you were on your BMX bike back when you were a kid, there's something really fueling about that and connected about it. You just feel like you're home again," he added of life on the lake. "I couldn't have been happier."
